settings.heading: Plug in by the window, set it once, and your home looks lived-in every time you leave.
settings.lede: For commuters, travellers and second-home owners: Kevin runs on a weekly schedule or switches on by itself when your phone leaves the area. Light, shadow and sound play from the device, so it keeps working when Wi-Fi is jammed.
settings.cta_heading: Ready to leave without the second thought?
settings.cta_subheading: Configure your Kevin and check out securely. Free shipping across the EU, 30-day returns, 3-year Swiss warranty.

settings.heading: Plug in. Choose a routine. Leave.
settings.body: No installation, no wiring, no monitoring contract. Kevin needs a power socket, a window that faces the street and a wall or ceiling for shadows.

settings.title: Plug in and place
settings.body: Set Kevin near a window that is visible from outside, with a wall or ceiling behind it for shadows. Connect the power adapter. Three buttons on the device start the essentials without the app.

settings.title: Set a schedule or use geofencing
settings.body: In the Kevin app, set a weekly schedule once, or switch on geofencing so Kevin starts by itself when your phone leaves the area. Leaving in a hurry no longer matters.

settings.title: Your home looks lived-in
settings.body: Warm light, moving silhouettes and everyday sounds play from the 32 GB inside the device, varying for up to four weeks without repeating. Nothing streams from the cloud, so a jammed Wi-Fi changes nothing.

settings.stat_1_label: Buttons on the device, no app needed to start

settings.heading: Built for the way you actually leave the house.
settings.body: A daily commute, a weekend away, a second home you visit once a month: Kevin follows the routine you set.

settings.image_alt: Kevin switches on when you leave for work
settings.title: Every working day
settings.body: Geofencing starts Kevin when you leave and stops it when you return. The house never has the dark, silent look that says nobody is home.

settings.title: Holidays and weekends
settings.body: Set the holiday schedule before you go. Evening after evening the light comes on, shadows move and the TV mutters, with no lamp on a timer at the same time every night.

settings.image_alt: Several Kevin devices managed in one app
settings.title: Second homes and rentals
settings.body: Put a Kevin in the chalet, the holiday flat or the office and manage them all from one app. Because scenes play locally, weak Wi-Fi on site is not a problem.

settings.heading: Burglars choose the easy, empty-looking house. Yours is not it.
settings.body: Most break-ins are opportunistic. A home that glows, moves and sounds occupied gets skipped for one that does not. Kevin makes that decision for them before the door is ever tested.

settings.title: Homes, flats, offices and shops
settings.body: Kevin covers one room per device. Place it where the street looks in: the living room, a ground-floor window, a shop front after hours. Larger homes or several facades: add a second unit and manage both in the app.
